history.title: My Story
paragraphs: I am a Systems Analyst and Full Stack Developer, graduated in Systems Analysis and Development from Universidade de Fortaleza (Unifor), with over 5 years of experience in the development and maintenance of institutional web systems.

I mainly work with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js, focusing on building scalable, accessible, and well-structured interfaces integrated with REST APIs and automated workflows. I have strong experience in the Moodle ecosystem, where I directly contributed to the evolution of educational platforms.

At Universidade de Fortaleza, I led the creation and evolution of the institutional EAD Unifor Design System, promoting visual standardization, component reuse, and continuous improvement in usability, accessibility, and performance across digital products.

I also developed and maintained process automations using Node.js, Selenium, web scraping, and API integrations, reducing operational errors, increasing internal workflow efficiency, and ensuring greater reliability in production environments.

I have experience with code versioning (Git), technical documentation, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment in cloud environments like AWS and Vercel. Currently, I am pursuing a postgraduate degree in DevOps and Cloud Architecture, deepening my knowledge in infrastructure, automation, and distributed environments.
